name: request-response
description: Windowed RPC round trips over one link - the network's most common interactive pattern (page fetches, queries, telemetry): each request a varied size, each naming a varied response size it wants back, the handler answering through the engine-gated allow list. Latency is the product; requests per second the capacity.
conformance: sent == delivered + timeouts; every response carries exactly the byte count its request named
